name: Centous Integration for Contact Form 7 and MailerLite
author: Centous Solutions

sections.description:
Centous Integration for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Formidable Forms and MailerLite allows you to seamlessly connect your WordPress forms with MailerLite.

Using this plugin, submissions from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, and Formidable Forms can be automatically sent to MailerLite as subscribers, helping you grow and manage your audience without manual data entry.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by MailerLite, Inc.

MailerLite® is a registered trademark of MailerLite, Inc.

Key Features

  • Integration with Contact Form 7
  • Integration with WPForms
  • Integration with Elementor Forms
  • Integration with Formidable Forms
  • Sync subscribers to MailerLite
  • Secure MailerLite authentication via API Key
  • Create and manage multiple feeds
  • Flexible field mapping
  • Support for MailerLite custom fields
  • Built-in connection testing
  • Detailed API request and error logging
  • Feed-based configuration system
  • Optional clean uninstall with data removal

Usage

  1. Connect your MailerLite account.
  2. Create a feed.
  3. Select the form plugin.
  4. Select the form.
  5. Map form fields to MailerLite fields.
  6. Save and activate the feed.

Supported form plugins:

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Elementor Forms
  • Formidable Forms

Configuration

Plugin Menu Structure

  • MailerLite Connect
  • Test Connection
  • Feeds
  • Logs
  • Settings

Feeds

Feeds determine how form submissions are sent to MailerLite.

Create a New Feed

  1. Go to MailerLite Connect → Feeds.
  2. Click Add New Feed.
  3. Select the form source:
  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Elementor Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  1. Select the form.
  2. Map MailerLite fields.
  3. Save and activate the feed.

Contact Form 7 Integration

Supported field types include:

  • Text
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Number
  • Date
  • Select
  • Checkbox
  • Radio
  • Textarea

WPForms Integration

Supported field types include:

  • Single Line Text
  • Name
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Number
  • Dropdown
  • Multiple Choice
  • Checkboxes
  • Date / Time
  • Paragraph Text

Elementor Forms Integration

The plugin automatically detects Elementor Forms fields and allows them to be mapped to MailerLite subscriber fields.

Supported field types include:

  • Text
  • Email
  • Tel
  • Number
  • Select
  • Radio
  • Checkbox
  • Date
  • Time
  • Textarea
  • Hidden
  • Acceptance

Formidable Forms Integration

The plugin parses Formidable Forms entries and maps field keys to MailerLite subscriber fields.

Supported field types include:

  • Text
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Number
  • Website
  • Textarea
  • Select
  • Radio
  • Checkbox
  • Date
  • Time
  • File (returns attachment URL)

Logs

Logs provide:

  • API requests
  • API responses
  • Success messages
  • Error details

Settings

Available options:

  • Enable / Disable Logging
  • Delete Data on Uninstall
  • Log Retention Period
  • Date Format Settings

Supported Form Plugins

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Elementor Forms
  • Formidable Forms

Plugin Features

  • MailerLite API Key authentication
  • Contact Form 7 integration
  • WPForms integration
  • Elementor Forms integration
  • Formidable Forms integration
  • Subscriber synchronization
  • Multiple feed support
  • Custom field mapping
  • Logging and debugging tools
  • Connection testing
  • Clean uninstall option

Author

Centous

Website:
https://www.centous.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Or install the plugin via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Install and activate Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Pro (for Elementor Forms), Formidable Forms, or any combination of them
  5. Go to MailerLite Connect → MailerLite Connect
  6. Connect your MailerLite account using an API Key
sections.faq:
Is Contact Form 7 required?

No.

Is WPForms required?

No.

Is Elementor Forms required?

No. You may use Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Formidable Forms, or any combination of supported form plugins.

Does Elementor Forms require Elementor Pro?

Yes. Elementor Forms is available through Elementor Pro.

Is Formidable Forms required?

No. Formidable Forms integration is available when the Formidable Forms plugin is installed and active.

What MailerLite objects are supported?

Currently, subscriber synchronization is supported.
